He never found out who wrote it, but he kept the note for the rest of his life.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一头沉睡的巨兽，呼吸绵长而沉稳。街灯把橘黄色的光洒在空无一人的柏油路上，偶尔一辆出租车低声驶过，尾灯在薄雾中拖出两道红线。早点铺的灯已经亮了，蒸笼里的白气从半掩的门缝涌出来，裹着面粉与葱花的香气。清洁工的扫帚有节奏地划过人行道，沙沙声像一首缓慢的曲子。天际线刚刚泛出一丝靛蓝，高楼的玻璃幕墙还没有学会反光。整座城市悬在黑夜与黎明之间，安静得近乎温柔。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem, like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\"—a simple version of the problem it can answer right away without calling itself again, so it doesn't keep going forever.\n• Imagine you're in a line of people and you want to know how many are behind you: you ask the person behind you, they ask the person behind them, and so on until the last person says \"zero\"—then each answer gets passed back up the line."}
